en: Ishaq ibn Ibrahim and Ishaq ibn Mansur narrated to us. They said: al-Nadr ibn Shumayl informed us. Shubah informed us, from Qatadah, from Anas ibn Malik. He said: When the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) came to Khaybar, he said: When we descend in the courtyard of a people, evil is the morning of those who were warned.
de: Ishaq ibn Ibrahim and Ishaq ibn Mansur überlieferte uns. They said: al-Nadr ibn Shumayl berichtete uns. Shubah berichtete uns, from Qatadah, from Anas ibn Malik. Er sagte: When der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm) came to Khaybar, he said: When we descend in the courtyard of a people, evil is the morning of those who were warned. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

en: Hamid ibn Umar narrated it to us. Abd al-Wahid narrated to us. Asim narrated to us. He said: I asked Anas ibn Malik: Did the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) make Madinah sacred? He said: Yes, from this place to that place. Whoever introduces an innovation in it, he said to me, has upon him the curse of Allah, the angels, and all people. Allah will not accept from him any compensation or replacement on the Day of Resurrection. Ibn Anas said: Or whoever gives refuge to one who introduces an innovation.
de: Hamid ibn Umar narrated it to us. Abd al-Wahid überlieferte uns. Asim überlieferte uns. Er sagte: I asked Anas ibn Malik: Did der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm) make Medina heilig? Er sagte: Yes, from this place to that place. Whoever introduces an innovation in it, he said to me, has upon him the Fluch of Allah, the angels, and all people. en: Zuhayr ibn Harb narrated to me. Yazid ibn Harun narrated to us. Asim al-Ahwal informed us. He said: I asked Anas: Did the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) make Madinah sacred? He said: Yes. It is sacred, and its fresh grass must not be cut. Whoever does that has upon him the curse of Allah, the angels, and all people.
de: Zuhayr ibn Harb überlieferte mir. Yazid ibn Harun überlieferte uns. Asim al-Ahwal berichtete uns. Er sagte: I asked Anas: Did der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm) make Medina heilig? Er sagte: Yes. It is heilig, and its fresh grass must not be cut. Whoever does that has upon him the Fluch of Allah, the angels, and all people. en: Qutaybah ibn Sa'id narrated to us, from Malik ibn Anas, as it was read to him, from Ishaq ibn Abd Allah ibn Abi Talhah, from Anas ibn Malik, that the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: O Allah, bless their measures, bless their sa, and bless their mudd.
de: Qutaybah ibn Sa'id überlieferte uns, from Malik ibn Anas, as it was read to him, from Ishaq ibn Abd Allah ibn Abi Talhah, from Anas ibn Malik, that der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm) said: O Allah, segne their measures, segne their sa, and segne their mudd. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

en: Zuhayr ibn Harb and Ibrahim ibn Muhammad al-Sami narrated to me. They said: Wahb ibn Jarir narrated to us. My father narrated to us. He said: I heard Yunus relate from al-Zuhri, from Anas ibn Malik, that the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: O Allah, place in Madinah twice the blessing that You placed in Makkah.
de: Zuhayr ibn Harb and Ibrahim ibn Muhammad al-Sami überlieferte mir. They said: Wahb ibn Jarir überlieferte uns. My father überlieferte uns. Er sagte: I heard Yunus relate from al-Zuhri, from Anas ibn Malik, that der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm) said: O Allah, place in Medina twice the segneing that You placed in Makka. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

en: Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah, Zuhayr ibn Harb, and Abu Kurayb all narrated from Abu Muawiyah. Abu Kurayb said: Abu Muawiyah narrated to us, from al-Amash, from Ibrahim al-Taymi, from his father. He said: Ali ibn Abi Talib addressed us and said: Whoever claims that we have something to read besides the Book of Allah and this document has lied. He said: A document was hanging from the sheath of his sword. It contained the ages of camels, matters of blood compensation, and these words of the Prophet (peace be upon him): Madinah is a sanctuary between Ayr and Thawr. Whoever introduces an innovation in it or gives refuge to one who introduces an innovation has upon him the curse of Allah, the angels, and all people. Allah will not accept from him any compensation or replacement on the Day of Resurrection. The protection granted by the Muslims is one; the least of them may grant it. Whoever claims descent from someone other than his father or attaches himself to masters other than his own has upon him the curse of Allah, the angels, and all people. Allah will not accept from him any compensation or replacement on the Day of Resurrection. Abu Bakr and Zuhayr's hadith ends at: the least of them may grant it. Their hadith does not mention the document hanging from his sword sheath.

en: Ali ibn Hujr al-Sa'di narrated to me. Ali ibn Mushir informed us. H; Abu Sa'id al-Ashajj narrated to me. Waki narrated to us. Both narrated from al-Amash, with the chain of Abu Kurayb from Abu Muawiyah and the same meaning to its end. It adds: Whoever violates the protection granted to a Muslim has upon him the curse of Allah, the angels, and all people. No compensation or replacement will be accepted from him on the Day of Resurrection. Their hadith does not contain: whoever claims descent from someone other than his father. Waki's narration does not mention the Day of Resurrection.

en: Ubayd Allah ibn Umar al-Qawariri and Muhammad ibn Abi Bakr al-Muqaddami narrated to me. They said: Abd al-Rahman ibn Mahdi narrated to us. Sufyan narrated to us, from al-Amash, with the chain and meaning of Ibn Mushir and Waki's hadith, except for the statement: whoever attaches himself to masters other than his own, and the mention of the curse upon him.
de: Ubayd Allah ibn Umar al-Qawariri and Muhammad ibn Abi Bakr al-Muqaddami überlieferte mir. They said: Abd al-Rahman ibn Mahdi überlieferte uns. en: Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah narrated to us. Husayn ibn Ali al-Jufi narrated to us, from Za'idah, from Sulayman, from Abu Salih, from Abu Hurayra, from the Prophet (peace be upon him), who said: Madinah is a sanctuary. Whoever introduces an innovation in it or gives refuge to one who introduces an innovation has upon him the curse of Allah, the angels, and all people. No compensation or replacement will be accepted from him on the Day of Resurrection.

en: Abu Bakr ibn al-Nadr ibn Abi al-Nadr narrated to us. Abu al-Nadr narrated to me. Ubayd Allah al-Ashja'i narrated to me, from Sufyan, from al-Amash, with this chain and the same meaning. He did not say: on the Day of Resurrection. He added: The protection granted by the Muslims is one; the least of them may grant it. Whoever violates the protection granted to a Muslim has upon him the curse of Allah, the angels, and all people. No compensation or replacement will be accepted from him on the Day of Resurrection.

en: Yahya ibn Yahya narrated to us. He said: I read to Malik, from Ibn Shihab, from Sa'id ibn al-Musayyib, from Abu Hurayra, that he used to say: If I saw gazelles grazing in Madinah, I would not frighten them. The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: What lies between its two lava fields is sacred.
de: Yahya ibn Yahya überlieferte uns. Er sagte: I read to Malik, from Ibn Shihab, from Sa'id ibn al-Musayyib, from Abu Hurayra, that he used to say: If I saw gazelles grazing in Medina, I would not frighten them. The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: What lies between its two lava fields is heilig. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

en: Ishaq ibn Ibrahim, Muhammad ibn Rafi, and Abd ibn Humayd narrated to us. Ishaq said: Abd al-Razzaq informed us. Ma'mar narrated to us, from al-Zuhri, from Sa'id ibn al-Musayyib, from Abu Hurayra. He said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) made sacred what lies between the two lava fields of Madinah. Abu Hurayra said: If I found gazelles between its two lava fields, I would not frighten them. He made twelve miles around Madinah a protected sanctuary.
de: Ishaq ibn Ibrahim, Muhammad ibn Rafi, and Abd ibn Humayd überlieferte uns. Ishaq said: Abd al-Razzaq berichtete uns. Ma'mar überlieferte uns, from al-Zuhri, from Sa'id ibn al-Musayyib, from Abu Hurayra. Er sagte: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) made heilig what lies between the two lava fields of Medina. Abu Hurayra said: If I found gazelles between its two lava fields, I would not frighten them. He made twelve miles around Medina a protected Heiligtum. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

en: Qutaybah ibn Sa'id narrated to us, from Malik ibn Anas, as it was read to him, from Suhayl ibn Abi Salih, from his father, from Abu Hurayra. He said: When people saw the first fruit, they brought it to the Prophet (peace be upon him). When the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) took it, he said: O Allah, bless our fruit, bless our city, bless our sa, and bless our mudd. O Allah, Ibrahim was Your servant, Your close friend, and Your prophet, and I am Your servant and Your prophet. He called upon You for Makkah, and I call upon You for Madinah with the like of what he asked You for Makkah and twice as much with it. Then he called for the youngest child present and gave him that fruit.
de: Qutaybah ibn Sa'id überlieferte uns, from Malik ibn Anas, as it was read to him, from Suhayl ibn Abi Salih, from his father, from Abu Hurayra. Er sagte: When people saw the first Frucht, they brought it to der Prophet (Friede sei auf ihm). When der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm) took it, he said: O Allah, segne our Frucht, segne our city, segne our sa, and segne our mudd. O Allah, Ibrahim was Your servant, Your close friend, and Your prophet, and I am Your servant and Your prophet. He called upon You for Makka, and I call upon You for Medina with the like of what he asked You for Makka and twice as much with it. Then he called for the youngest Kind present and gave him that Frucht. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

en: Yahya ibn Yahya narrated to us. Abd al-Aziz ibn Muhammad al-Madani informed us, from Suhayl ibn Abi Salih, from his father, from Abu Hurayra, that the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) was brought the first fruit and said: O Allah, bless our city, our fruits, our mudd, and our sa, blessing upon blessing. Then he gave it to the youngest child present.
de: Yahya ibn Yahya überlieferte uns. Then he gave it to the youngest Kind present. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.
